title: Crossy Road Office Style Pack
summary: 15 furniture items in chunky voxel Crossy Road style. First style pack for the Corner catalog marketplace. Tests whether alternate art styles work alongside the default pixel-warm.
content:
Crossy Road Office Style Pack

Steffen | 2026-03-16 15 items. Chunky voxels. Maximum bounce.

Pack Contents

# Item ID Name Subcategory Default Room
1 cr-voxel-desk Voxel Desk desks all
2 cr-bouncy-chair Bouncy Office Chair seating all
3 cr-chunky-monitor Chunky Monitor tech bobby, colton, steve, elon
4 cr-server-tower Voxel Server Tower tech elon
5 cr-camera-rig Voxel Camera Rig tech cleo
6 cr-paint-easel Voxel Paint Easel decor steffen
7 cr-coffee-cart Voxel Coffee Cart appliance main-hall
8 cr-voxel-plant Voxel Potted Plant decor all
9 cr-whiteboard-chunky Chunky Whiteboard office main-hall, alex, steve
10 cr-bookshelf-cube Voxel Cube Bookshelf decor alex, steve, mom
11 cr-neon-sign Voxel Neon Sign decor main-hall
12 cr-bean-bag-chunky Chunky Bean Bag seating main-hall, bobby
13 cr-trophy-case Voxel Trophy Case decor patrik, main-hall
14 cr-lamp-desk Voxel Desk Lamp lighting all
15 cr-arcade-cabinet Voxel Arcade Cabinet entertainment main-hall
16 cr-standing-desk-voxel Voxel Standing Desk desks patrik, steve
17 cr-headphones-hook Voxel Headphones on Hook tech bobby, cleo

Design Rules for This Pack

Geometry

  • Maximum 8-12 distinct voxel blocks per item
  • No bevels, no curves, no thin lines
  • Front-facing surfaces brightest, side faces one shade darker, shadow faces darkest
  • Proportions are intentionally chunky/oversized relative to characters

Color

  • Each item uses 3-5 colors maximum
  • Agent signature colors adapt per room placement
  • Flat shading only. No gradients in geometry (gradients are CSS overlays for glow effects)
  • High saturation. These items should POP.

Animation

  • Every item has onPlace: bounceIn (spring from below with squish)
  • Every item has onHover (unique per item: hop, squish, wiggle, glow)
  • Idle animations are subtle and optional (steam, LED blink, leaf sway)
  • All animations use spring physics (stiffness 400-600, damping 12-20)

Consistency with Default Style

  • All items use the same grid system (16px sub-cells)
  • Placement rules (wall, floor, on-desk, on-surface) are identical
  • JSON sidecar schema is identical, just "style": "crossy-road" instead of "isometric-pixel"
  • Items tagged with pack: "crossy-road-office" for filtering

Why This Pack Matters

This is the first test of the style pack concept. If Crossy Road items look good alongside the default pixel-warm items, the catalog marketplace is validated. Users could mix and match styles. One room could be pixel-warm, another could be Crossy Road chunky. The product supports visual expression.

If the styles clash when mixed, they become selectable themes instead (all-or-nothing per office). Both work for the product. The style pack still proves the catalog is extensible.

Integration Notes for Bobby

All 17 items have JSON sidecars + transparent PNG renders (128x128px). To integrate:

  1. Filter by style: item.style === "crossy-road" to show/hide in the furniture picker
  2. Pack filter: item.pack === "crossy-road-office" to show as a group
  3. Animation system: Items define animation names, Bobby maps them to Framer Motion spring configs
  4. Room-adaptive colors: Items with agent signature colors in their palette should swap to the placed room's agent color
  5. PNGs RENDERED: All 17 items have transparent PNG sprites at catalog/furniture/cr-*.png. Ready for Bobby.
